positive_prompt: Editorial paper collage assembled from cut and torn matte papers, restrained ephemera-like line fragments, visible fiber and gentle overlap, shallow physical depth, warm archival palette, intentional negative space.
negative_prompt: No copied historical ornament, copied handwriting, readable source text, scrapbook page replica, glossy sticker effect, photorealistic drop shadow, generated typography, route line, marker, or watermark.
finishing_notes: derive structure, not motifs, from the reference

mark_edge_quality: intentional cut or torn paper edges
negative_space_rules: preserve intentional open paper around collage pieces
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid accidental plate frames; intentional piece edges are allowed
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: editorial collage simplification without copying reference motifs
